desc: The trash PANDA by Q is the Quickie Fast-Attach version of our half NELSON silencer. Designed with practical shooters in mind who wish to suppress multiple platforms, this silencer is short, lightweight, and hearing safe. 100% titanium construction with a PVD coating, fully rotary welded with no outer tube, and features standard size wrench flats on the front and back for easily install and removal. Each trash PANDA comes with a 1/2x28 and a 5/8-24 Cherry Bomb muzzle brake.
